purpose: Matched E0/E1 direct-target test of the SD3-derived relative resolution shift on MiniMax H3. The user's existing MP node still determines the normal sampler-1 base canvas; a new geometry-only helper mirrors the downstream refine node's scale=1.20 target before Continuum so E can sample directly at the post-refine canvas without executing learned upscale/refine.

model_chain.keep: existing DiffAid -> Untwist -> Spectrum MODEL chain, then H3RuntimeMetricsProbe, then H3 Continuum Sampler V3.4
remove_or_bypass: MiniMax H3 Latent Upscaler + Refine (3D) execution

insert.placement: between the SA-Solver scheduler SIGMAS output and H3 Continuum Sampler V3.4 SIGMAS input

reference_basis.source_role: analytic H3-Base/native resolution regime; auto-derived from the geometry-only pre-sampler target; no source-resolution pass is executed
reference_basis.official_basis: H3-Base is documented as 768p and H3 output shorter side defaults to 768 px
reference_basis.aspect_matching: source_width=source_height=0 invokes the pinned H3 native canvas rule: 768px short edge, 768*1344 area cap, per-axis round to 32. For the current 896x928 target this resolves to 768x800.
reference_basis.note: Current example: MP base 736x768 -> geometry-only refine scale 1.20 -> direct E target 896x928 -> auto H3-native reference 768x800. All target dimensions remain dynamic.

runs.invariant: Resolution-Aware Sigmas output must be bit-exact equal to its input SIGMAS.

required_diagnostics.note: For the current 896x928 target. Other picture aspects/sizes derive their own H3-native reference automatically.

keep_existing: H3RefineTargetGeometry at scale 1.20 / align 32 / keep_proportion true

matched_invariants: refine target geometry scale=1.20 / align=32 / keep_proportion=true

expected_structure.note: Actual H3 NFE / Spectrum forecast split may differ between E0 and E1 because sigma coordinates change.
expected_structure.sa_solver_timing: Default tau window stays tied to effective supplied sigma; remapping may move which outer indices are stochastic without changing any sampler widget.
expected_structure.resolution_event: exactly one resolution_sigma_map event per graph execution with mode/factor/effective shift/sigma delta

decision_rule.before_decoding: Do not tune strength or calibrated_factor.
decision_rule.if_positive: Only then test the same remap combined with accepted D10 progressive+temporal.
decision_rule.if_neutral_or_negative: Leave resolution-aware sigmas experimental/off; do not start a strength sweep from this pair.

metrics_probe.placement: after Spectrum and before H3 Continuum Sampler V3.4
metrics_probe.purpose: passive model/sampler-call telemetry only; no capture, guidance, progressive, or attention behavior

output.metrics: connect to both H3ResolutionAwareSigmas.metrics and H3MetricsJSON.metrics; leave the probe's optional metrics input unconnected
output.autosave: retain the same metrics JSON capture used by D10

target_geometry.base_source: existing pre-Continuum MP sizing node outputs

insert.placement: between the existing MP width/height outputs and the dimensions used by Continuum for E

target_geometry.semantics: Mirrors the integrated LBH refine node's scale-by-multiplier sizing before sampler 1. It performs no learned upscale and no refinement sampling.
